purpose: Verify that the complete one-zone pad/pod/load-cell assembly preserves acceptable validation behavior across repeated center and off-axis load placements before four-zone duplication.

vendor_reference.vendor_guidance: single-point load cells support off-axis platform loading; placement on the scale surface should not materially change the result when the system is correctly installed

project_trial.cross_position_spread: report diagnostic only; do not invent a vendor corner-load tolerance

geometry_rules: record the actual contact-footprint length, width, and centroid for every placement
entire declared rectangular contact footprint must remain inside the 105 x 78 mm zone pad
CENTER must use the smallest radial centroid offset of the five declared positions
+X and -X must lie on opposite sides of the X axis
+Y and -Y must lie on opposite sides of the Y axis
the same load object or load adapter/contact interface must be used for all position trials
mechanical_rules: positive overload-stop clearance must remain at every placement
no cable or strain-relief force introduced by repositioning
fixture remains positively secured to the bench
